label: Chromatin methylation and epigenetic silencing
reason: Histone/DNA methylation, PRC2, NuRD, CHD remodellers, imprinting and X inactivation; one odd GO term (organism emergence).

label: Axon growth, guidance and regeneration
reason: Sema3A repulsion, CRMPs, axon sprouting and regeneration; ceramide signalling is a minor outlier.

label: Cardiac injury repair: fibrosis and cardiomyocyte growth
reason: Fibroblast/myofibroblast/ECM fibrosis terms plus cardiomyocyte proliferation and regeneration, linked as the two arms of cardiac remodelling after injury.

label: Pancreatic beta-cell insulin secretion
reason: KATP channels, incretins, FFAR1, insulin processing and beta-cell hallmark; a few insulin-action terms are minor.

label: Cadherin adherens junctions
reason: E-cadherin trafficking/degradation, adherens junction assembly and calcium-dependent cell-cell adhesion.

label: Post-transcriptional mRNA decay and miRNA silencing
reason: ARE-binding proteins, deadenylation, decapping, miRNA/siRNA biogenesis and RISC; target-specific translation terms fit.

label: Potassium channels and membrane excitability
reason: K2P (TWIK/TREK/TASK/THIK/TRESK), KATP and Ca-activated K channels setting resting potential and hyperpolarisation.

label: Myeloid/granulocyte differentiation
reason: Granulopoiesis transcription, neutrophil and myeloid progenitor differentiation, promyelocyte modules; one generic cell-cycle module.

label: Iron, heme and oxygen transport
reason: Transferrin cycle, ferroportin/DMT1/ceruloplasmin defects, heme scavenging and erythrocyte gas exchange; selenium and superoxide are minor outliers.

label: Epithelial-mesenchymal glandular branching morphogenesis
reason: Prostate and salivary branching, budding and epithelial-mesenchymal signalling; limb bud and genitalia fit the same inductive theme.

label: Inorganic anion transport and biomineralization
reason: SLC4/SLC26/SLC20 anion transporter diseases plus enamel/dentin/tooth and ectopic calcification, linked by bicarbonate/phosphate supply for mineralization (FAM20C phosphorylation fits).

label: Oxidative stress, mitochondrial respiration and ferroptosis
reason: H2O2/ROS responses, oxidative-stress apoptosis, ferroptosis and regulation of electron transport/OXPHOS form one redox theme.

label: mRNA 3'-end processing and nuclear export
reason: Cleavage/polyadenylation, histone mRNA stem-loop processing, termination and mRNA/snRNA export.

label: Triglyceride and lipid droplet metabolism in adipocytes
reason: TAG synthesis/lipolysis, lipid droplets, lipophagy, glycerol/PA metabolism and adipogenesis; fructose terms are minor.

label: Sprouting angiogenesis and VEGF signalling
reason: Endothelial proliferation, migration and VEGF production/signalling regulating sprouting angiogenesis.

label: Regulated cell death: apoptosis, necroptosis, pyroptosis
reason: Death-receptor/caspase-8 signalling, necroptosis and inflammasome-driven pyroptosis are interlinked inflammatory cell-death pathways.

label: Lipoprotein metabolism and cholesterol transport
reason: Chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly, remodelling and clearance, ABCA1 efflux and LXR control of cholesterol.

label: Skeletal myogenesis and muscle regeneration
reason: Myoblast commitment, proliferation, fusion, differentiation and satellite-cell regeneration.

label: Cytoplasmic translation initiation
reason: eIF2/eIF3, 43S complex, scanning, 60S joining and stress control of initiation; elongation term minor.

label: Amino acid catabolism and nitrogen metabolism
reason: Glutamate, aspartate, tyrosine/phenylalanine, glycine, proline, threonine metabolism plus glycine conjugation and gluconeogenesis.

label: ITAM immunoreceptor signalling: FcR, mast cell, BCR
reason: Fc-epsilon mast cell degranulation, Fc-gamma phagocytosis/ADCC and BCR signalling share the Syk/BTK/PLCgamma ITAM mechanism.

label: Cardiac excitation-contraction and calcium handling
reason: Cardiac action potential phases, conduction system, ion channels, SR calcium release/reuptake and contraction force.

label: Neuronal cell adhesion molecules and axon domains
reason: L1-family/ankyrin, neurofascin, Na channel clustering, paranodes and DSCAM/SDK/nectin neuronal adhesion.

label: Neutrophil and myeloid inflammatory activation
reason: Neutrophil chemotaxis, respiratory burst, degranulation, formyl peptide receptors and myeloid modules.

label: Heart and vascular muscle development
reason: Cardiomyocyte proliferation/differentiation, trabeculation, adaptation, and coronary/aortic smooth muscle development.

label: Antigen processing and presentation
reason: MHC class I/II loading, cross-presentation, proteasomal processing and viral MHC evasion.

label: Insulin secretion and insulin action on glucose uptake
reason: Beta-cell secretion (KATP, incretins) plus insulin receptor/IRS/AKT2/GLUT4 signalling, linked by the insulin axis of glucose homeostasis.

label: Insulin-stimulated glucose and fatty acid uptake
reason: GLUT4 translocation, insulin sensitivity, adiponectin and fatty acid uptake/oxidation in metabolic tissues.

label: T cell receptor signalling and activation
reason: TCR/CD3/ZAP70, CD28 and co-inhibition, T cell activation modules; few B cell terms are minor.

label: tRNA/rRNA modification and mitochondrial gene expression
reason: Nuclear tRNA/rRNA processing and modification plus mitochondrial transcription/translation, linked by translation machinery biogenesis; a few unrelated terms (DNA topology, heterotetramerization).

label: Pre-mRNA processing, splicing and nuclear export
reason: Polyadenylation, histone mRNA processing, snRNP assembly, spliceosome and mRNA export.

label: B cell activation and germinal centre response
reason: B cell modules, memory B cells, GC differentiation, Tfh/ICOS and BCR signalling.

label: Selective autophagy and mitochondrial quality control
reason: Autophagosome formation/fusion, mitophagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy and mitochondrial fission/fusion.

label: Amino acid and peptide transmembrane transport
reason: SLC6/SLC36/SLC15 amino acid and oligopeptide transporters and their aminoacidurias; histamine metabolism minor.

label: Nuclear RNA exosome processing and surveillance
reason: 3'-5' exonucleolytic decay, ncRNA 3'-end trimming, tRNA processing and nuclear RNA surveillance.

label: Dopaminergic reward and drug addiction behaviour
reason: Dopamine receptor signalling, DARPP-32, nicotinic receptors and responses to cocaine, amphetamine, nicotine and ethanol.

label: NF-kappaB signalling
reason: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kB activation via TNFR1, NIK, LUBAC and its regulation.

label: Erythroid heme, iron and gas transport
reason: Heme biosynthesis, iron uptake, hemoglobin O2/CO2 exchange, Rh ammonium transport and erythrocyte differentiation.

label: Microglia and amyloid-beta in Alzheimer's disease
reason: Amyloid formation/clearance, APP processing, tangles and microglial activation; axon regeneration and protein import are minor.

label: Antiviral innate immunity and type I interferon
reason: RIG-I/MDA5, cGAS-STING, endosomal TLR, IRF3/7 activation and interferon-stimulated responses.
